body.query: query PrBatch($owner: String!, $repo: String!) { rateLimit { remaining resetAt } repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { pullRequests(first: 100, states: [OPEN], orderBy: {field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { nodes { number updatedAt author { login } state } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } mergedBaseline: pullRequests(first: 1, states: [MERGED], orderBy: {field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { nodes { updatedAt } } }  }
